reuse.why: Extends the existing shared getDateWithSkippedWeekend with a holidays parameter and threads it through every existing caller instead of adding a parallel path.

duplication.why: The rule is not copied, but the occurrence lookahead for holidays is computed separately and differently in three places (getNextDate `+2*len`, getUpcomingDates `+2*len`, getDatesInRange `3*len` margin).

placement.why: Day classification and shifting live in shared/schedules.ts, the field in RecurConfig and parseRecurDate, and callers only pass the config through.

scope.why: All edits implement holiday handling, plus focused tests.

maintainability.why: isNonWorkingDay and the stepping loop make the rule clear and single-sourced; the ad hoc per-caller margin formulas are the weak spot.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All three weekend-adjustment paths (getNextDate, schedules/app.ts applyWeekendSkip, schedule-template getOccurrenceDay) call getDateWithSkippedWeekend.

disguised_duplication.where: The rule is shared; the margin computations in getUpcomingDates/getDatesInRange/getNextDate are separate heuristics, not disguised copies of the rule.

one_place.where: packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts getDateWithSkippedWeekend (with isNonWorkingDay) decides holiday/weekend moves and daily skips for every caller.
